contentText:
Sleep trackers detect sleep via a combination of motion, heart rate, and temperature sensors.

Oura's getting sued.

A recently filed class-action complaint against the smart ring maker alleges that the company has duped customers by claiming it can accurately track different sleep stages. A smart ring can't possibly do that, the suit says, because the Oura Ring doesn't directly measure your brain waves.
